rust_summary: players' inventories and ender chests, live or saved, on Host (`player_inventory`, `move_player_stack`, `take_player_stack`, `put_player_stack`).
doc_summary: `Host::player_inventory(uuid, ender)` reads a player's 41 inventory slots or 27 ender chest slots (live, or from their file when away); `move_player_stack`, `take_player_stack` and `put_player_stack` change them one checked stack at a time, so a mod's menu (an `/invsee`, `/enderchest`, a clan chest) never copies or loses an item. Bundles need "hooks": @API:host_player_inventories@.
